info.title: GO-GO Ride API
info.description:
**Smart local transport for West Bengal** - bus timetable search, arrival alarms,
owner-listed buses with admin verification, local cars, shared rides and bookings.

One API serves all three surfaces: the passenger app, the public website and the admin panel.

### Trying it out
1. Run `POST /auth/login` with a seeded account below.
2. Copy `data.accessToken` from the response.
3. Click **Authorize** at the top right and paste it.
4. Every padlocked endpoint is now callable.

| Role | Phone | Password |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Super admin | `9876500001` | `Admin@123` |
| Admin | `9876500002` | `Admin@123` |
| Bus owner | `9876543210` | `Owner@123` |
| Passenger | `9123456789` | `Rider@123` |
| Driver | `9000011223` | `Driver@123` |

### Conventions
- Every response is `{ success, message, data }`; list endpoints add `meta` with pagination.
- Times are `HH:mm` (24h); responses also carry a `...12h` field for display.
- Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`, stored at midnight UTC.
- Phone numbers are 10 digits; `+91` is accepted and stripped.

get.summary: Search buses - the Search Results screen
get.description: Returns each bus timed for the requested stop pair. Buses that do not run on the chosen date are **included** with `isRunning: false` and a reason, so the app can show the 'Not Running' card instead of hiding them. Direction-aware: the boarding stop must precede the arrival stop in the timetable.

post.summary: Submit a bus for verification - the Add Bus form
post.description: Bus owners only. Created as PENDING and invisible to passengers until approved.

post.summary: Set an alarm - the Set Alarm screen
post.description: The expected arrival time is read from the bus timetable at the boarding stop, so the client never sends it. Rejected if the bus does not run that day, the stops are in the wrong order, or an alarm already exists.
